{
 "path": "programs/task-55230baa.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Separator rows/columns are uniform lines; each enclosed panel is tested
    # for repeated marker cells. Mark panels with 2+ markers as 1.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    bg = next((grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols and
               sum(1 for rr in range(h) if rr not in sep_rows for cc in range(w) if cc not in sep_cols and grid[rr][cc] == grid[r][c]) > 0), 0)
    # Grid's panel background is the most common non-separator color.
    vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols]
    bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    marker = min((v for v in set(vals) if v != bg), key=lambda v: vals.count(v))
    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        row = []
        r0, r1 = rb[ri]+1, rb[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            c0, c1 = cb[ci]+1, cb[ci+1]
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
            row.append(1 if n >= 2 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
"
